title: Choosing stays — budget
text: For a budget trip, target simple guesthouses, hostels or well-reviewed budget hotels near a transit-friendly area. Compare total price, cancellation terms, room cooling/heating, distance from the station and recent guest feedback. Do not assume amenities from a price tier.

title: Choosing stays — balanced
text: For a balanced trip, choose a verified mid-range hotel or heritage-style stay close to the planned neighbourhood. In Jaipur, old city versus Amber has different logistics; in Udaipur, old city versus Fateh Sagar changes walking and evening access. Check current reviews and pickup logistics before booking.

title: Choosing stays — premium
text: For premium trips, compare heritage hotels, palace stays and lake/desert properties by location, transfer time, inclusions and cancellation terms—not marketing labels alone. Desert properties need special scrutiny for transport, camp standards and included activities.

title: Choosing stays for wildlife
text: For Ranthambore, select a stay only after a safari is actually booked or its reporting point is known. Confirm whether transfers are included and leave time for the safari check-in process.
